# Gridlings

> Free daily logic grid puzzle in the browser. Fill an N×N grid so every row
> and column contains each animal once and each color once, every animal–color
> pair appears exactly once, and the same animal never touches itself — not
> even diagonally. Every published board is machine-verified to have exactly
> one solution reachable by pure deduction (no guessing). New puzzle daily at
> 00:00 UTC; unlimited free play in three difficulties. No account, no
> download, no ads. English and Chinese.

- [Play today's puzzle](https://play.agiscorecard.com/): daily board + free play
- [中文版](https://play.agiscorecard.com/zh): same game, Chinese interface
- [Balance](https://play.agiscorecard.com/balance): sister puzzle — 6×6 binary balance grid (Binairo family, like LinkedIn's Tango): three suns and three moons per row/column, never three in a row, same machine-verified unique-solution guarantee. Chinese: https://play.agiscorecard.com/zh/balance
- [Star Battle](https://play.agiscorecard.com/starbattle): third puzzle — daily 10x10 two-star Star Battle (the full-strength format one-star clones don't offer), same machine-verified unique-solution guarantee. Chinese: https://play.agiscorecard.com/zh/starbattle
- [Trail](https://play.agiscorecard.com/trail): fourth puzzle — daily Zip-style path puzzle (draw one line, hit numbers in order, fill every cell), machine-verified unique solutions. Chinese: https://play.agiscorecard.com/zh/trail
- [Futoshiki](https://play.agiscorecard.com/futoshiki): daily inequality Latin-square puzzle. Chinese: https://play.agiscorecard.com/zh/futoshiki
- [Towers](https://play.agiscorecard.com/towers): daily Skyscrapers puzzle. Chinese: https://play.agiscorecard.com/zh/towers
- [Mini Sudoku](https://play.agiscorecard.com/minisudoku): daily 6×6 sudoku with 2×3 boxes — the five-minute version of the classic. Chinese: https://play.agiscorecard.com/zh/minisudoku
- [Kropki](https://play.agiscorecard.com/kropki): daily dot-logic Latin square — white dot = consecutive, black dot = double, no dot = neither (the absence is a clue). Chinese: https://play.agiscorecard.com/zh/kropki
- [Sandwich](https://play.agiscorecard.com/sandwich): daily sum-logic Latin square — each clue is the sum sandwiched between 1 and the largest number in its line. Chinese: https://play.agiscorecard.com/zh/sandwich
- [Thermometers](https://play.agiscorecard.com/thermo): daily fill puzzle — mercury rises from each bulb without gaps; row/column counts must match the clues. Chinese: https://play.agiscorecard.com/zh/thermo
- [Nonogram](https://play.agiscorecard.com/nonogram): daily 10×10 picture-logic (paint-by-numbers) puzzle — every board machine-verified solvable by pure line logic, never a guess. Chinese: https://play.agiscorecard.com/zh/nonogram
- [Gridlings-Bench](https://play.agiscorecard.com/bench): open LLM reasoning benchmark — 1,100 machine-verified constraint puzzles across the 11 families, exact-match scoring, CC BY 4.0. Direct download: https://play.agiscorecard.com/bench-v1.json
- [Archive](https://play.agiscorecard.com/archive): replay every past Gridlings daily
- Embed: append `?embed=1` to either URL inside an iframe — free to embed with attribution.
- Built by [AGI Scorecard](https://agiscorecard.com/), the AGI-prediction evidence ledger. Not affiliated with LinkedIn or The New York Times; "games like LinkedIn Queens/Tango" is a descriptive comparison only.
